title: Logistic regression on the scikit-learn digits dataset
brief: Train a multinomial logistic-regression classifier on the handwritten digits dataset bundled with scikit-learn (sklearn.datasets.load_digits; its data file inside the package is sklearn/datasets/data/digits.csv.gz). Standardise the features, hold out a stratified 25% test split using the seed, and report test accuracy and macro-averaged F1. Also report the accuracy of a most-frequent-class reference on the same split, so the result has something to be compared with. Produce one figure: the confusion matrix on the test split.
